main.description: Acceptance of a bid on an RFP

rfp.description: Strong reference to the rfp record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.rfp).

bid.description: Strong reference to the bid record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.bid.x402).

payload.description: Strong reference to the accept record if there is anything to note about the acceptance (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.accept.x402).
